samples.summary: Deriving the wait set from `document.fonts` turns every registered family into a hard gate, widening the lane's dependency on fonts.googleapis.com far beyond the families a capture actually paints. The bootstrap link (`buildGoogleFontsHref`, font-catalog.data.ts) registers ~8 eager families (Noto Sans/Serif KR, Nanum Gothic, Nanum Myeongjo, Gothic A1, Gowun Dodum/Batang, Roboto) plus index.html's Inter/Fraunces/JetBrains Mono, on every page load of every slides/docs section. The new `load()` forces a woff2 fetch for each of them and `pending()` then requires each to reach `loaded`, so a transient CDN failure on a Korean family that appears in no screenshot now fails the whole visual run (exit 1 at the end) even when all 220 targets match pixel-for-pixel. The originating issue's outcome was to stop a font race from producing wrong screenshots; this approach adds a new, broader flake/failure surface and sits against the doc's Goal 'Keep verification deterministic and reproducible between local and CI' (docs/design/harness-engineering.md:121). Scoping the gate to the families the captured targets actually render (or the vendoring the task doc lists as out of scope) would fit the issue better.
samples.evidence: pending(): `if (!statuses.includes("loaded")) missing.push(...)` applied to every family in `registry()`, which is built from all of `document.fonts`.

samples.summary: The new ~120-line font-settling routine is inlined in verify-visual-browser.mjs and not shared, while the sibling capture script keeps a bare `await document.fonts.ready` — the exact weakness this PR argues is insufficient. The task doc records it as a known limitation, but no shared helper module was introduced, so the two screenshot capture paths will keep diverging.

When a pass captured with unusable webfonts, the run still writes `.actual.png`/diffs and prints the standard guidance 'Inspect mismatches and refresh intended baselines: pnpm frontend test:visual:browser:update' before the webfont failure exit. That advice is actively wrong for a fallback-glyph run (the script itself refuses `--update` in that state a few hundred lines earlier), so the operator-facing output contradicts itself.
samples.evidence: `console.error("[verify:visual:browser] Inspect mismatches and refresh intended baselines: ...")` runs regardless of `webFontFailures`, while the update path exits 1 with 'Refusing to record baselines from fallback glyphs.'

samples.summary: Module-level mutable state (`webFontRefetchExhausted`, `webFontFailures`) plus stylesheet-href rewriting for cache-busting is a fair amount of bespoke machinery for a verification script; it is what the task plan asked for, but it makes the capture harness carry retry/backoff policy that would be simpler as a per-run option or as vendored font bytes.

verdict.reason: The mechanism the finding describes is present verbatim. registry() (verify-visual-browser.mjs:385-396) is built by iterating all of `document.fonts`; load() (399-413) forces a fetch for every (family, weight) in it; and pending() (415-439) contains exactly the quoted gate — `if (!statuses.includes("loaded")) missing.push(...)` at 425-427 — applied to every family in that registry, with no scoping to the families the captured targets actually paint. The consequence the finding claims is also real: an unresolvable family records a webFontFailure (490) and the script exits 1 at 754-756 after all pixel comparisons have already passed, so a transient CDN failure on a non-painted family fails a run in which every target matched. The cited doc Goal exists at docs/design/harness-engineering.md:121. One reviewer detail is overstated: the ~8 eager Korean families (font-catalog.data.ts:6-49) reach the DOM only through useGoogleFontsLink(), whose sole callers are slides-view.tsx:230 and docs-view.tsx:210, and the visual harness page (harness/visual/page.tsx:23-27) mounts scenario components rather than SlidesView/DocsView (themed-font-picker.tsx:39-40 confirms the picker injects nothing). However, index.html:12 registers Fraunces/Inter/JetBrains Mono on every page load, so the over-broad gate still applies across all capture passes including sections that paint none of them — the blast radius is smaller than described, not absent. No refutation ground holds: the code is as described, nothing guards it into unreachability, and 'approach fit / new failure surface vs. the issue outcome' falls under this lens's Scope & approach fit bullet. Confidence is low only because the finding leans on a Goal rather than a named acceptance criterion or Non-Goal, which leaves its major-vs-minor status genuinely arguable; per instructions that uncertainty keeps the finding.

finding.summary: Hardcoded font list duplicates the existing single-source-of-truth font catalog and will drift from it
finding.evidence: `VISUAL_FONT_FAMILIES` / `VISUAL_FONT_WEIGHTS` are hand-maintained in the harness script, but the app already has an authoritative registry: `packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/font-catalog.ts` (`FONT_CATALOG`, `buildGoogleFontsHref()`, per-entry `weights`, `eager` flag), documented as the "Single source of truth for the shared font-family picker". The bootstrap link the harness must wait on is literally `FONT_CATALOG.filter(f => f.webFont && f.eager)` plus the three families in `packages/frontend/index.html:12`. Enumerating them a third time by hand is exactly the drift that this PR is fixing — the next catalog regeneration (`scripts/build-font-catalog.mjs`) silently re-opens the same bug class. Deriving the list (or at minimum asserting it against the catalog in a test) fits the repo's reuse expectation better.

verdict.reason: The described code does not exist in this repository. A repo-wide grep for VISUAL_FONT_FAMILIES|VISUAL_FONT_WEIGHTS matches only a review artifact and the task TODO doc — never verify-visual-browser.mjs; a grep for FONT_FAMILIES|FONT_WEIGHTS across all .mjs files returns zero matches. The script's only font constants are FONT_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS (line 357) and FONT_REFETCH_ATTEMPTS (line 361). waitForFontsReady() derives the awaited set at runtime from document.fonts itself: registry() (lines 385-396) collapses every registered face to family -> declared weights (parsing variable-font weight ranges), and load()/pending() (lines 399-439) operate solely over that derived map, re-reading it each poll tick (line 453). The only literal family names in the file are in explanatory comments (lines 322, 327). The comment at lines 331-335 states the intent directly: the awaited set is derived from document.fonts "rather than from a hand-kept family list", so it "cannot drift" from index.html, FONT_CATALOG's eager set, or lazily injected links. The task doc (lines 64-66, 72-74) records that the hand-kept list was deliberately removed because it drifts. The finding evidently describes a superseded revision (first plan, doc line 44); the remedy it prescribes — deriving the list — is precisely what the current code implements, so there is no duplicated font catalog to consolidate.

finding.summary: The new family list is still incomplete against its own stated rule — 4 of the 8 eager catalog families are missing
finding.evidence: The comment states "The list must include the families the *app itself* pulls from fonts.googleapis.com", but `FONT_CATALOG_DATA` marks eight entries `eager: true` (Noto Sans KR, Noto Serif KR, Nanum Gothic, Nanum Myeongjo, Gothic A1, Gowun Dodum, Gowun Batang, Roboto — font-catalog.data.ts lines 6-9,13-15,49). The diff adds Inter/Fraunces/JetBrains Mono from index.html but still omits Nanum Myeongjo, Gothic A1, Gowun Dodum and Gowun Batang, all of which the bootstrap `ensureGoogleFontsLink()` request fetches over the network. Any baseline that paints those families remains subject to the same swap race the PR claims to close (the catch-all `status !== "loading"` poll only covers faces already requested, not ones a paint has not yet triggered).

verdict.reason: The finding assumes verify-visual-browser.mjs carries a hand-maintained family list that omits 4 of the 8 eager catalog families. In this repository the script has no family list at all: waitForFontsReady derives the wait set from document.fonts itself (registry() at :385-396 iterates every registered FontFace and collapses to family -> declared weights), then loads every (family, weight) pair and re-reads the registry each 100ms poll tick (:398-413, :441-456), so every eager catalog family (Nanum Myeongjo, Gothic A1, Gowun Dodum, Gowun Batang included) plus each lazily injected per-family link is awaited automatically once its faces register. The comment the reviewer quotes ("The list must include the families the app itself pulls from fonts.googleapis.com") does not exist anywhere under packages/frontend; the actual comment at :331-335 documents the registry-derived design explicitly so the wait "cannot drift" from index.html and FONT_CATALOG's eager set. The pending check is also not a catch-all status !== "loading" poll: it asserts per-family "at least one face loaded" plus per-weight fonts.check() (:415-439). The only hardcoded eager-family list in the repo (build-font-catalog.mjs:42-43) contains all eight families. That registry-derived enumeration is the counterexample.
